if(R36_BUILD_HORIZON_STEREO_RUNNER)
  set(STEREO_RUNNER_INSTALL_DIR "lib/perception_ros_so_demo")
  add_subdirectory(runner "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/runner")
endif()
if(R36_BUILD_ALGORITHM_DEMO)
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake/nv12.cmake")
  add_library(stereo_provider STATIC src/stereo_provider.cpp)
  target_compile_features(stereo_provider PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(stereo_provider PUBLIC include PRIVATE "${R36_PROJECT_ROOT}/compare/runner/include"
    "${R36_PROJECT_ROOT}/core/runtime/include")
  target_include_directories(stereo_provider SYSTEM PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(stereo_provider PUBLIC perception::sdk stereo_nv12 ${OpenCV_LIBS})
  if(R36_BUILD_HORIZON_STEREO_RUNNER)
    target_compile_definitions(stereo_provider PRIVATE R36_ONLINE_WITH_HORIZON=1)
    target_link_libraries(stereo_provider PRIVATE horizon_stereo)
  endif()
endif()
